menu:11036550:1.text: Wow, you brought back so much grass!
menu:11036550:1.source_cn: 哎呀！您带回了这么多草！

say:1:1623326001:1.text: You've heard of the Lyceum newspaper, right?
say:1:1623326001:1.source_cn: 你应该知道莱希拉姆的秘闻社吧？
say:1:1623326001:1.male: You've heard of the Lyceum newspaper, right?
say:1:1623326001:1.female: You've heard of the Lyceum newspaper, right?

choice_prompt:2:1623326001.text: You've heard of the Lyceum newspaper, right?

choice_prompt:2:1623326001.male: You've heard of the Lyceum newspaper, right?
choice_prompt:2:1623326001.female: You've heard of the Lyceum newspaper, right?

say:3:1623326002:1.text: That's them. The so-called "all-knowing" secret paper.
say:3:1623326002:1.source_cn: 没错，正是那个号称“无所不知”的秘密报社。
say:3:1623326002:1.male: That's them. The so-called "all-knowing" secret paper.
say:3:1623326002:1.female: That's them. The so-called "all-knowing" secret paper.

say:4:1623326003:1.text: Recently, some of their freelance reporters have been publishing rather exaggerated stories.
say:4:1623326003:1.source_cn: 最近，秘闻社的外包记者们发布了一些过于夸张的报道。
say:4:1623326003:1.male: Recently, some of their freelance reporters have been publishing rather exaggerated stories.
say:4:1623326003:1.female: Recently, some of their freelance reporters have been publishing rather exaggerated stories.

say:5:1623326004:1.text: The news has crossed the line of standard reporting and is causing needless alarm among the students.
say:5:1623326004:1.source_cn: 报道内容已经超出“正常新闻描述”的范畴，在学生中造成了...
say:5:1623326004:1.male: The news has crossed the line of standard reporting and is causing needless alarm among the students.
say:5:1623326004:1.female: The news has crossed the line of standard reporting and is causing needless alarm among the students.

say:6:1623326005:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please find out where it came from so the school can deal with it accordingly.
say:6:1623326005:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please find out where it came from so the school can deal with it accordingly.
say:6:1623326005:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please find out where it came from so the school can deal with it accordingly.

choice:2:1:2.text: Yeah, I even tried applying as a freelancer once.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 我还应聘过他们的外包记者呢
choice:2:1:2.male: Yeah, I even tried applying as a freelancer once.
choice:2:1:2.female: Yeah, I even tried applying as a freelancer once.

say:0:1623327001:0.text: I'm curious to see what those reporters cooked up this time...
say:0:1623327001:0.source_cn: 那些记者又搞出什么花样来，还真有点期待……
say:0:1623327001:0.male: I'm curious to see what those reporters cooked up this time...
say:0:1623327001:0.female: I'm curious to see what those reporters cooked up this time...

say:0:1623328001:0.text: Lumivale, huh... Alright. I'll head over and see what's going on.
say:0:1623328001:0.source_cn: 是求知魔法村啊……我去看看到底是怎么回事。
say:0:1623328001:0.male: Lumivale, huh... Alright. I'll head over and see what's going on.
say:0:1623328001:0.female: Lumivale, huh... Alright. I'll head over and see what's going on.

say:4:1623330003:1.text: Oh! Uh, hello, Magister. Can I help you with something?
say:4:1623330003:1.source_cn: 唔？这位魔法师大人，您找我有什么事？
say:4:1623330003:1.male: Oh! Uh, hello, Magister. Can I help you with something?
say:4:1623330003:1.female: Oh! Uh, hello, Magister. Can I help you with something?

choice_prompt:5:1623330003.male: Oh! Uh, hello, Magister. Can I help you with something?
choice_prompt:5:1623330003.female: Oh! Uh, hello, Magister. Can I help you with something?

say:6:1623330004:1.text: A report? Oh! Yeah, a couple days back, some students in Lyceum uniforms came through here. They asked a million questions, and kept going on about how it had to be "a real hook", something that would "make people gasp".
say:6:1623330004:1.source_cn: 报道？前两天是有几个穿着莱希拉姆学生校服的人来问东问西...
say:6:1623330004:1.male: A report? Oh! Yeah, a couple days back, some students in Lyceum uniforms came through here. They asked a million questions, and kept going on about how it had to be "a real hook", something that would "make people gasp".

say:8:1623330005:1.text: What?! That's not news. That's a downright horror story!
say:8:1623330005:1.source_cn: 什么？！这哪里是眼前一亮啊，这是眼前一黑！
say:8:1623330005:1.male: What?! That's not news. That's a downright horror story!
say:8:1623330005:1.female: What?! That's not news. That's a downright horror story!

say:9:1623330006:1.text: I told them plain as day, our ewe had a lamb a little while back. Cutest thing I've ever seen, snow-white, like a puff of cloud that wandered down from the sky!
say:9:1623330006:1.source_cn: 我明明跟他们说的是我家母羊前阵子下了只崽儿，这小家伙，...
say:9:1623330006:1.male: I told them plain as day, our ewe had a lamb a little while back. Cutest thing I've ever seen, snow-white, like a puff of cloud that wandered down from the sky!
say:9:1623330006:1.female: I told them plain as day, our ewe had a lamb a little while back. Cutest thing I've ever seen, snow-white, like a puff of cloud that wandered down from the sky!

say:10:1623330007:1.text: And what do they call it? "An evil creature". Dura above, that's downright slander! That lamb is the sweetest little treasure in our whole home!
say:10:1623330007:1.source_cn: 结果他们居然说什么“邪恶生物”？艾雅在上，这是污蔑！我...
say:10:1623330007:1.male: And what do they call it? "An evil creature". Dura above, that's downright slander! That lamb is the sweetest little treasure in our whole home!
say:10:1623330007:1.female: And what do they call it? "An evil creature". Dura above, that's downright slander! That lamb is the sweetest little treasure in our whole home!

say:11:1623330008:1.text: If I'm being honest, we're all completely taken with it. We're even thinking of keeping it like a proper house pet.
say:11:1623330008:1.source_cn: 不瞒您说，我们一家人都特别喜欢这小家伙，甚至都打算把它...
say:11:1623330008:1.male: If I'm being honest, we're all completely taken with it. We're even thinking of keeping it like a proper house pet.
say:11:1623330008:1.female: If I'm being honest, we're all completely taken with it. We're even thinking of keeping it like a proper house pet.

say:12:1623330009:1.text: I was just about to go cut it some fresh grass... but it threw a little fit earlier and wouldn't let me out of its sight.
say:12:1623330009:1.source_cn: 我还正准备去给它弄点鲜嫩的青草呢……不过刚才它闹腾了一...
say:12:1623330009:1.male: I was just about to go cut it some fresh grass... but it threw a little fit earlier and wouldn't let me out of its sight.
say:12:1623330009:1.female: I was just about to go cut it some fresh grass... but it threw a little fit earlier and wouldn't let me out of its sight.

say:13:1623330010:1.text: So, um... Magister, I hate to ask, but I can't step away right now. Could you grab some fresh grass for it instead?
say:13:1623330010:1.source_cn: 那个……魔法师大人，恐怕我现在走不开了，能拜托你给它弄...
say:13:1623330010:1.male: So, um... Magister, I hate to ask, but I can't step away right now. Could you grab some fresh grass for it instead?
say:13:1623330010:1.female: So, um... Magister, I hate to ask, but I can't step away right now. Could you grab some fresh grass for it instead?

choice_prompt:14:1623330010.text: So, um... Magister, I hate to ask, but I can't step away right now. Could you grab some fresh grass for it instead?
choice_prompt:14:1623330010.source_cn: 那个……魔法师大人，恐怕我现在走不开了，能拜托你给它弄点青草来吗？
choice_prompt:14:1623330010.male: So, um... Magister, I hate to ask, but I can't step away right now. Could you grab some fresh grass for it instead?
choice_prompt:14:1623330010.female: So, um... Magister, I hate to ask, but I can't step away right now. Could you grab some fresh grass for it instead?

choice:5:0:1.text: I'm following up on a report.
choice:5:0:1.male: I'm following up on a report.
choice:5:0:1.female: I'm following up on a report.

say:0:1623331001:0.text: Right. Of course. Guess it's my turn to take care of the "evil creature".
say:0:1623331001:0.source_cn: 果然是这样……好吧，现在轮到我伺候“邪恶生物”了。
say:0:1623331001:0.male: Right. Of course. Guess it's my turn to take care of the "evil creature".
say:0:1623331001:0.female: Right. Of course. Guess it's my turn to take care of the "evil creature".

say:0:1623332001:0.text: This should last the little lamb a few days. Time to bring it back to the farmer.
say:0:1623332001:0.source_cn: 这些草应该够小羊吃几天了，回去交给农夫吧。
say:0:1623332001:0.male: This should last the little lamb a few days. Time to bring it back to the farmer.
say:0:1623332001:0.female: This should last the little lamb a few days. Time to bring it back to the farmer.

say:1:1623333001:1.text: On behalf of my little lamb, thank you!
say:1:1623333001:1.source_cn: 我替我家的小羊谢谢您了！
say:1:1623333001:1.male: On behalf of my little lamb, thank you!
say:1:1623333001:1.female: On behalf of my little lamb, thank you!

choice_prompt:2:1623333001.text: On behalf of my little lamb, thank you!
choice_prompt:2:1623333001.source_cn: 我替我家的小羊谢谢您了！
choice_prompt:2:1623333001.male: On behalf of my little lamb, thank you!
choice_prompt:2:1623333001.female: On behalf of my little lamb, thank you!

say:3:1623333002:1.text: We did! We came up with thirty names, then picked the one that rolls off the tongue best.
say:3:1623333002:1.source_cn: 名字？取了取了！我们全家一起想了三十个名字，最后选了一...
say:3:1623333002:1.male: We did! We came up with thirty names, then picked the one that rolls off the tongue best.
say:3:1623333002:1.female: We did! We came up with thirty names, then picked the one that rolls off the tongue best.

say:4:1623333003:1.text: We're calling it "Lamb". What do you think?
say:4:1623333003:1.source_cn: 就叫“小羊”，您觉得怎么样？
say:4:1623333003:1.male: We're calling it "Lamb". What do you think?
say:4:1623333003:1.female: We're calling it "Lamb". What do you think?

choice_prompt:5:1623333003.text: We're calling it "Lamb". What do you think?
choice_prompt:5:1623333003.source_cn: 就叫“小羊”，您觉得怎么样？
choice_prompt:5:1623333003.male: We're calling it "Lamb". What do you think?
choice_prompt:5:1623333003.female: We're calling it "Lamb". What do you think?

say:6:1623333004:1.text: You think so too? Perfect! I'm telling everyone at home!
say:6:1623333004:1.source_cn: 您也觉得好？太好了，我一定要告诉我家人！
say:6:1623333004:1.male: You think so too? Perfect! I'm telling everyone at home!
say:6:1623333004:1.female: You think so too? Perfect! I'm telling everyone at home!

say:7:1623333007:1.text: Well, name or no name, you brought it so much food. It's going to be thrilled!
say:7:1623333007:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，您为它带来了这么多的食物，小羊也肯定会很开心的！
say:7:1623333007:1.male: Well, name or no name, you brought it so much food. It's going to be thrilled!
say:7:1623333007:1.female: Well, name or no name, you brought it so much food. It's going to be thrilled!

say:9:1623333005:1.source_cn: 正是，我就觉得这个名字最适合它！

say:10:1623333006:1.text: Uh... I guess we don't think alike...
say:10:1623333006:1.source_cn: 呃……看来咱们的想法不太一样……
say:10:1623333006:1.male: Uh... I guess we don't think alike...
say:10:1623333006:1.female: Uh... I guess we don't think alike...

choice:5:2:3.text: That's not a name, that's a label.
choice:5:2:3.male: That's not a name, that's a label.
choice:5:2:3.female: That's not a name, that's a label.

choice:2:0:1.text: So, did you give it a name yet?
choice:2:0:1.male: So, did you give it a name yet?
choice:2:0:1.female: So, did you give it a name yet?

say:1:1623334001:1.source_cn: 秘闻社报道的新闻是否属实？

say:1:1623334001:1.female: So, about that news report. Any truth to it?

choice_prompt:2:1623334001.female: So, about that news report. Any truth to it?

say:3:1623334002:1.text: So that's what it was. A complete farce.
say:3:1623334002:1.male: So that's what it was. A complete farce.
say:3:1623334002:1.female: So that's what it was. A complete farce.

say:4:1623334003:1.text: Still, if nobody's actually in danger, it might be better to let the students argue it out and learn how to spot nonsense on their own.
say:4:1623334003:1.source_cn: 不过既然不涉及实际安全威胁，这类事情或许让学生们自行辨...
